question: In the month of March 2022, who was given the captaincy of Royal Challengers Bangalore for IPL 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Faf du Plessis__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Faf du Plessis was appointed as the captain of the Royal Challengers Bangalore (RCB) for the IPL 2022 season.
 
• This decision came after Virat Kohli stepped down from the captaincy role following the previous season.
 
• Du Plessis had previously been a successful captain for the Chennai Super Kings, leading them to an IPL title in 2021. 
 
• He was known for his calm and composed leadership style, as well as his ability to perform consistently with the bat.
 
• His appointment as RCB captain was met with optimism by the franchise's fans, who hoped that he could lead the team to their first-ever IPL title.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Virat Kohli:** Former captain of RCB and Indian cricket team. He stepped down from RCB captaincy before the start of IPL 2022.
 
• **Finn Allen:** A young and talented cricketer from New Zealand. He was not considered a leadership candidate for RCB in 2022.
 
• **Glenn Maxwell:** A powerful all-rounder for RCB. While he is a valuable asset to the team, he was not appointed as the captain for IPL 2022.
